title: Multi-omics reveals microplastics disrupt nitrogen assimilation in hydrophytes
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00824G, Paper
Pan Weiliang, Lin Zhang, Lin Liang, Meirui Mu, Chang Xu, Lianfeng Du, Xuan Guo
Hydrophytes mitigate water eutrophication; however, microplastics (MPs) and nanoplastics (NPs) may affect nutrient removal. The underlying pathways through which MPs/NPs mediate disruptions in nitrogen assimilation remain unclear. This study investigates...
